systems.platform: not stated; each county's own platform, required to offer web, mobile and USSD channels and to interoperate with IFMIS, the Business Registration Service and the Integrated Population Registration System
systems.owner: each county government, with the County Treasury as lead implementing agency and the County ICT Directorate for hosting, licensing and integration
systems.tiers: county governments; the gazette of 27 July 2026 finds fragmented and manual processes, limited automation and vendor lock-in in some counties
named as a designated government platform county revenue systems must interoperate with

note: Binding standards for county own-source revenue systems, gazetted 27 July 2026 (Gazette Notice No. 11488): a rule about an application, stating requirements and general weaknesses but no county's deployment, and nothing about the connection of county offices.
